# Medical Debt Rights - Protection &amp; Relief [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Know your medical debt rights. New credit reporting rules, charity care, negotiation, and bankruptcy options for medical bills.

## About
medicaldebtrights.com is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
